failure: Disk write I/O error or permission denied
expected_behavior: Reject event with PersistenceError, escalate to DLQ, no false acknowledgment
actual_behavior: Event routed to DLQ with state=DLQ; no false ack returned
recovery: Operator inspects DLQ, repairs filesystem, triggers safe pinned replay

failure: SIEM endpoint unavailable (503 Service Unavailable / Timeout)
expected_behavior: Isolate failure; canonical raw and UCE records remain intact; retry via OutboxDispatcher; escalate to DLQ on max attempts
actual_behavior: OCSF/OTel deliver successfully; Outbox tracks retry attempts; canonical UCE and raw store remain invariant
recovery: Automatic exponential retry via OutboxDispatcher; DLQ inspection on terminal exhaustion

failure: Partition buffer capacity full (traffic spike / slow consumers)
expected_behavior: Enforce backpressure; raise BufferFullError under REJECT; route to DLQ under DLQ policy; zero silent loss
actual_behavior: BufferFullError raised or overflow routed to DLQ with metric increment
recovery: Scale worker consumers or drain buffer

expected_behavior: Capture poison event into DLQ with full error context; acknowledge stream offset so stream does not stall
actual_behavior: DLQRecord created; worker acks stream message; pipeline continues processing subsequent events
recovery: Operator fixes parser pack or mapping; replays from DLQ

failure: Process receives SIGINT / SIGTERM shutdown signal
expected_behavior: Stop polling, finish inflight tasks, flush outputs, unacknowledged tasks nack'd for replay
actual_behavior: Graceful drain executes within timeout; status transitions to STOPPED cleanly
recovery: Process exits cleanly; restart safely resumes from committed offsets
